title: Triggers
description:
## Triggers
A trigger automatically runs SQL when something happens to a table - INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE.
```sql
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_name
AFTER INSERT ON table_name
BEGIN
    -- SQL to run automatically
END;
```

You can use `BEFORE` or `AFTER`, and `NEW` refers to the new row being inserted/updated, `OLD` refers to the row being deleted/updated.

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER log_new_user
AFTER INSERT ON users
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO audit_log (action, details)
    VALUES ('NEW_USER', NEW.name);
END;
```
Now every time a user is inserted, the audit log updates automatically.
